datasets.name: Landslide vector data
datasets.source: Authors' own fieldwork and visual interpretation on Google Earth
datasets.verbatim: Based on the historical landslide data and combined with fieldwork verification, landslides in the study area were vectorized and labeled by visual interpretation on Google Earth to obtain landslide boundary information, and a total of 732 landslide vectors were obtained.

datasets.name: Sentinel-1A SAR data
datasets.verbatim: SAR data are adopted from Sentinel-1A data obtained from the Alaska Satellite Facility (ASF, https://asf.alaska.edu/) website.

datasets.name: ALOS 12.5 m DEM Resolution
datasets.source: Advanced Land Observing Satellite (ALOS) phased array L-band synthetic aperture radar (PALSAR)
datasets.verbatim: Slope and aspect were calculated based on DEM data with ALOS 12.5 m DEM Resolution. ALOS 12.5 m DEM data were elevation data produced by using advanced land observing satellite (ALOS) phased array L-band synthetic aperture radar (PALSAR).

methods.name: Multi-input channel U-Net
methods.summary: A U-Net based semantic segmentation network modified with multiple input channels to ingest multisource data (SAR, optical, and terrain) and an attention mechanism module integrated into the skip connections to adjust spatial weights and focus on landslide features.
methods.verbatim: In this study, a multi-input channel U-Net landslide detection method fusing SAR, optical, and topographic multisource remote sensing data is proposed. ... The multi-input channel U-Net network model was constructed by combining Python language with TensorFlow as the base framework.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked or referenced, and the custom code for the multi-input channel U-Net lacks a repository or persistent link.
